_comment_project_name: No spaces — used as ChromaDB collection name. Use underscores.

llm._comment_base_url: OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Examples: 'http://localhost:11434/v1' for Ollama, 'https://api.openai.com/v1' for OpenAI
llm._comment_api_key: Use 'dummy' for local models. Use your actual API key for hosted providers.

embedding._comment_type: 'local' uses sentence-transformers locally. 'api' uses an OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint.
embedding._comment_match: IMPORTANT: embedding config must match what was used during extraction or retrieval will silently return wrong results.

_comment_reranker: Set to null to disable. Enable with: {"model": "BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3", "type": "cross_encoder"}. Requires sentence-transformers. type: "late_interaction" (e.g. {"model": "answerdotai/answerai-colbert-small-v1", "type": "late_interaction"}) uses ColBERT-style MaxSim scoring via sentence_transformers.MultiVectorEncoder instead of a cross-encoder — requires sentence-transformers >= 6.0. Only one method runs at a time.
_comment_agentic: Set to null to disable. Enable with: {"page_index_path": "../extraction/my_project_docs_extracted/page_index.json", "max_chars_per_page": 8000, "max_steps": 6, "section_top_n": 5, "section_char_budget": 15000}. Requires re-running extraction to generate page_index.json, plus the deepagents package. A deepagents agent decides for itself how many search/read cycles to run, bounded by max_steps (mapped to LangGraph's recursion_limit). search_sections_tool returns up to section_top_n reconstructed sections per call, sharing section_char_budget characters; read_page_tool (whole-page, capped at max_chars_per_page) stays as an escape hatch.
_comment_k_retrieve: Per-channel retrieval depth: how many candidates each channel (dense vector search, BM25) fetches BEFORE fusion, decoupled from the reranker pool size (k_standard/k_deep_dive). Reciprocal Rank Fusion truncates its merged output back to the pool size, so when this is null each channel effectively contributes only ~half its candidates. Setting it deeper than the pool (e.g. 80 vs a 40 pool) widens recall without growing reranker cost, which tracks pool size. null = per-channel depth equals the pool size.
_comment_top_n: Docs kept after cross-encoder reranking. Only used when reranker is enabled.
_comment_expansion_char_budget: Total characters parent-section expansion may add across all surviving docs. Each survivor is expanded from the chunk that was retrieved to the full text of its section, rebuilt from the corpus JSONL (uncapped). This budget stops one very large page — SHAPER's biggest section is ~55,000 chars — from crowding the context window; sections that no longer fit are left as the retrieved chunk.
_comment_bm25_enabled: BM25 keyword search fused with vector search via Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Requires <project_name>_docs.jsonl next to chromadb_path (produced by extraction); if that file is missing the chatbot warns at startup and falls back to pure vector search. Set false to A/B against pure vector search.
_comment_title_boost_enabled: Third RRF list: BM25 over chunk TITLES only, collapsed to one hit per page. A question naming a class or identifier is an entity lookup — that token is one of ~150 in a chunk body but the whole of a page's title, so this channel is far more precise for 'what does X do' questions than body BM25 or dense search. Requires bm25_enabled. Set false if your pages have uniform or repeated titles, where it degrades to injecting arbitrary pages into the rerank pool.
_comment_hyde_enabled: Opt-in HyDE: before vector search, an LLM writes a short hypothetical documentation passage and that passage (not your literal question) is embedded and searched. Helps when questions are phrased very differently from the docs. BM25 and reranking still use the real question. Costs one extra LLM call per question.
